title: Good Faith Estimates for Self-Pay Visit Package Purchases
content:
Cash-pay patients buying a Self-Pay Visit Package receive a written Good Faith Estimate, and a patient whose billed charges come in sufficiently above that estimate may use the federal patient-provider dispute process. The figures that govern the estimate and the dispute right are the same on every tier.

| Tier | Written Good Faith Estimate before purchase | Lead time before the first scheduled visit | Dispute threshold (billed charges above the estimate) | Dispute window after the date of the bill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Core 8-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Required | 1 business day | $400.00 | 120 calendar days |

**Explanatory notes**

- The *lead time* is counted in business days before the first scheduled visit by which the Good Faith Estimate must be given.
- The *dispute threshold* is the amount by which total billed charges must exceed the Good Faith Estimate for the patient to be eligible for the federal patient-provider dispute process.
- The *dispute window* is counted in calendar days after the date of the bill, within which the patient may start the dispute process.
